meta.title: Americano Open
meta.description: Mobile-first platform for team signup, approvals, and live tournament brackets.

common.demoMode: Demo mode is active. Add `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` to connect the real backend.

home.title: Americano tennis, organized with zero chaos.
home.description: Team signup, approvals, public team pages, and live tournament brackets in one clean flow for pairs and staff.
pitchSteps: Create one account for your team of two.
Email your payment proof to the tournament inbox.
Get accepted by the admin and wait for the bracket lock.
home.playersTitle: A clean path from signup to first serve.
home.playersDescription: The public and team-facing experience is designed for phones first, so registration status and the live bracket are always easy to check.

featureCards.title: Fast team signup
featureCards.body: One account captures both names and immediately tells the team where to send payment proof.

featureCards.title: Clear approval state
featureCards.body: Every team sees whether its registration is pending, approved, or rejected, without chasing admins over chat.

featureCards.title: Live tournament board
featureCards.body: Once the setup is approved, the public bracket becomes the source of truth for the tournament.

home.publishedTitle: Live progression teams can actually read on mobile.
home.publishedDescription: The board updates as winners advance, so players always have one clear place to check the tournament.
home.emptyBrackets: No live bracket yet. The admin will approve the starting order once all 32 teams are confirmed.

signUp.title: Save your team a place in the next draw.
signUp.description: Create one account for your pair, send payment proof by email, and the admin will approve your team before the bracket is locked.
steps: 1. Create one account for your team of two.
3. Wait for admin approval and watch the live bracket.
signUp.paymentNotice: After signup, send your payment proof to {paymentEmail}. Once it is accepted, your team will be approved for the tournament.

errors.supabase: Supabase is not configured yet. Add the environment variables to enable real signups.

login.title: Track your team status and tournament details.
login.description: Teams can log in to review approval status, update team details, and confirm how the live bracket is progressing.
login.pendingInfo: Pending teams can still log in. Your team page will show whether the registration is still awaiting admin review.
login.teamMissingMessage: Your auth account exists, but the team row is missing in the database. That usually means the Supabase trigger that creates `teams` did not run correctly at signup.
login.registeredMessage: Account created. You can log in now and track your team approval status from your team page.

errors.password: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.teamMissing: Login succeeded, but your team row is missing from the database. Check the `handle_new_user` trigger or create the `teams` row for this user.
errors.supabase: Supabase is not configured yet. Add the environment variables to enable login.

brackets.description: As soon as the admin locks the setup, the live tournament board appears here for every team and visitor.
brackets.empty: No live bracket is published yet.
brackets.publishHint: Publish when assignments are final and accepted teams are set.

playerProfile.description: Public team details shown to other players and visitors.
playerProfile.emptyBio: This team has not added a bio yet.

me.description: This page keeps the team informed about registration status and published tournament information.
me.published: The live bracket is available now.
me.notPublished: The bracket is not locked yet.
me.paymentHelp: If your registration is still pending, email your payment proof to {paymentEmail}. Once the admin accepts it, your team can be placed into the main draw.

admin.title: Keep approvals and brackets moving.
admin.description: The admin view focuses on the tournament bottlenecks that matter most: confirming teams, locking setup, and advancing winners live.

players.title: Accept teams into the tournament.
players.description: This screen is intentionally desktop-friendly and operational: review team details and mark whether the registration stays pending, approved, or rejected.

brackets.title: Build the starting order and lock the main draw.
brackets.description: Set the exact 32-team starting order. Position 0 plays 1, 2 plays 3, and so on. Once approved, setup becomes read-only and the progress dashboard takes over.
brackets.createDescription: Drag confirmed teams into the ordered list on the right. That ordered list becomes the saved bracket start order in the database.
brackets.selectionHelp: Build the right-hand order exactly as you want the tournament to start.
brackets.publishingDescription: Live bracket visibility follows setup approval in this tournament mode.
brackets.availableDescription: Drag teams into the setup list, or drop them back here to remove them.
brackets.selectedDescription: This exact order is saved to the database. Pairings are 0 vs 1, 2 vs 3, and so on.
brackets.noAvailableTeams: All confirmed teams are already in the starting order.
brackets.emptySelection: No teams selected yet. Build the starting order here.
brackets.pairingHelp: Pairings are automatic from the saved order: 0 vs 1, 2 vs 3, 4 vs 5, and so on.
brackets.sizeValue: Fixed at 32 teams and 6 progress columns.
brackets.approvalDescription: Approving the bracket validates the setup, locks the order, seeds round one into the progress table, and opens the tournament progress dashboard.

progress.title: Advance winners across the live bracket.
progress.description: Use the Won button on any occupied slot to move that team into the next column at floor(i / 2).
progress.lockedOnly: This page only becomes active after the bracket setup is approved and locked.
